svg.title: Lattice dispersion of the pond's wave scheme
svg.desc: Phase speed, group speed and angular frequency of plane waves on the nine-point and five-point lattices at Courant number 0.5, against the continuum. Wavelengths of the pond's pebbles span 11 to 42 cells, where the error is at most about one percent.
svg.text: Plane waves on the discrete pond. The continuum is the line at 1 (left, middle) and omega = c k (right).
short waves lag: they carry energy
slower than the crest speed suggests
Courant number 0.5 is isotop's ceiling (Wave::advance); the 9-point stencil is stable to sqrt(3)/2 = 0.866, the 5-point to 1/sqrt(2) = 0.707.
The Klein-Gordon term (0.5 per s squared) and the damping are left out here; see the source-band figure on View Ripple.
